_doc: Probabilistic starter priors. P(start) is never set to 1.0 from a report alone.

unknown_model._doc: logit P(start) = intercept + b_share*logit(recent start share) + b_b2b_second*[team on 2nd night of B2B AND goalie started night 1] + b_rest*min(days_rest,3)

stale_report_hours._doc: A report available more than this many hours before puck drop is stale: it is not used to name a starter and is flagged.
